1582.summary: The class explores the Psalms to understand the nature of Christ as the Son of God, emphasizing his divine sonship and relationship with God the Father. It delves into psalms like Psalm 110 and Psalm 2, highlighting Christ's unique position and the divine origin of his existence.

1583.summary: The class explores the title 'Son of Man' used by Jesus, emphasizing his humility and servitude to God. It draws parallels between Jesus and the psalms, highlighting his role as a servant and his relationship with his mother Mary, and encourages listeners to reflect on their own relationship with God.

1584.summary: The class explores the concept of the Word made flesh through the Psalms, emphasizing God's creative power and the transformative power of His word in creation and salvation. It highlights the importance of understanding and internalizing God's word to become new creations in Christ.

1585.summary: The class explores the Psalms as a testament to Christ's role as the Redeemer, emphasizing His sacrifice and salvation. It delves into Psalms that foreshadow Christ's mission and His ultimate triumph over sin and death.

1586.summary: The class explores the fulfillment of the law of Moses through the Psalms, emphasizing that principles of righteousness existed before the law and were embodied in Jesus Christ. It discusses the way of the Lord and the importance of faith and sacrifice in expressing one's relationship with God.

1587.summary: The class explores Christ's kingship through the Psalms, emphasizing his role as King of Righteousness and Peace, his future reign, and his dual nature as king and priest. It highlights Christ's compassion and the ultimate victory of his kingdom over all nations.
